OpenBareMap Ireland — Garmin Montana 750i

1. Use a microSD card supported by the Montana 750i (up to 32 GB), formatted FAT32.
2. Connect the device or card to your computer. Create a Garmin folder at the card root if needed.
3. Copy OpenBareMap-Ireland.img into that Garmin folder. Keep existing map files.
4. Safely eject and restart the Montana.
5. In Setup > Map > Configure Maps, enable OpenBareMap Ireland. If Automatic Maps is enabled, turn it off to select this map manually. Disable overlapping detailed maps while reviewing it; keep the worldwide DEM basemap enabled.
6. Under Setup > Units, set elevation to metres. Garmin stores native contour values in feet and uses the device unit setting to display them; geometry is spaced every 10 m.
7. Start with normal map detail. Advanced map settings control text size, zoom levels and, where available, shaded relief.

This map covers Ireland and Northern Ireland, with 10 m contours, native elevation data and custom topographic styling. It has no turn-by-turn routing. Device track recording and separately loaded GPX tracks are independent of this map.

The file has been compiled and its binary contents checked, but has not yet been tested on a Montana 750i. Check Carrauntoohil for contour spacing/units, textured bog, cliff markings, roads and place names. Device rendering and performance still need that practical test.

Keep ATTRIBUTION.txt and the accompanying terrain notices available with copies of the map.
